beats.visual:
Editor complet a .git/hooks/pre-commit:
```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess

source = subprocess.check_output(
    ["git", "show", ":helloGit.py"], text=True
)
compile(source, "helloGit.py", "exec")
```
Ressaltar primer la ruta i després :helloGit.py.
